create_task.title: Create task
create_task.description: Create one task. It lands pending whatever status the caller asked for, and its id is server-minted.

list_tasks.title: List tasks
list_tasks.description: List the tasks matching the filter. Narrow by status, priority or run, and pass a limit unless you genuinely need the whole board.

get_task.title: Read task
get_task.description: Read one task, its labels resolved.

update_task.title: Update task
update_task.description: Replace the mutable fields of one task. A status change is checked against the lifecycle, and moving from pending to in_progress is refused while anything still blocks it.

delete_task.title: Delete task
delete_task.description: Soft-delete one task. It stops being readable and its row stays.

unblock_task.title: Unblock task
unblock_task.description: Release one task from its hold and record why.

get_task_by_name.title: Read task by name
get_task_by_name.description: Read one task by the project-scoped name a person quotes, such as MVP-001.

args.description: The project the name is scoped to.

create_task_in_project.title: Create task in project
create_task_in_project.description: Create one task inside a project, minting its project-scoped name from the project's prefix and writing the membership.

args.description: The project to create it in.

assign_task.title: Assign task
assign_task.description: Hand one task to a worker. A task whose dependencies are unmet is held rather than dispatched.

args.description: The worker to hand it to.
The run this assignment belongs to.

unassign_task.title: Unassign task
unassign_task.description: Take one task back off whoever holds it.

unblock_dependents.title: Unblock dependents
unblock_dependents.description: Sweep everything waiting on one finished task and release whatever has nothing left to wait for.

upsert_agent.title: Write worker
upsert_agent.description: Create the worker with this identifier or merge into the one already there. The identifier is the key and never changes.

list_agents.title: List workers
list_agents.description: List every worker this instance knows.

get_agent_by_agent_id.title: Read worker by identifier
get_agent_by_agent_id.description: Read one worker by its identifier in whatever system runs it.

get_agent.title: Read worker
get_agent.description: Read one worker by its storage key, falling back to its external identifier.

args.description: The worker's storage key or external identifier.

create_project.title: Create project
create_project.description: Create one project. Its key is derived from its name and its id is server-minted.

list_projects.title: List projects
list_projects.description: List every project that has not been deleted.

get_project.title: Read project
get_project.description: Read one project by its storage key.

update_project.title: Update project
update_project.description: Replace the mutable fields of one project.

delete_project.title: Delete project
delete_project.description: Soft-delete one project and drop every membership pointing at it. The tasks themselves are left alone.

list_tasks_in_project.title: List a project's tasks
list_tasks_in_project.description: List the tasks that are members of one project.

args.description: The project whose tasks to list.

add_task_to_project.title: Add task to project
add_task_to_project.description: Record that one task belongs to one project. A task may belong to several.

args.description: The project to add it to.

remove_task_from_project.title: Remove task from project
remove_task_from_project.description: Drop one task's membership of one project. The task itself is left alone.

args.description: The project to remove it from.

list_projects_for_task.title: List a task's projects
list_projects_for_task.description: List the projects one task belongs to.

args.description: The task whose projects to list.

create_relationship.title: Create edge
create_relationship.description: Write one directed edge between two things. Re-writing an edge that already exists returns it unchanged rather than writing a second.

delete_relationship.title: Delete edge
delete_relationship.description: Remove the one edge identified by its two ends and its label.

traverse_relationships.title: Traverse edges
traverse_relationships.description: List the edges of one label touching one thing, in the direction asked for. Anything other than inbound reads as outbound.

args.description: inbound for edges pointing at it, outbound for edges leading away.

import_project.title: Import project
import_project.description: Read a project and its tasks out of one document and write them, returning what was created. Runs to completion before answering.

args.description: The document to read the project out of.

start_import_project.title: Start import
start_import_project.description: Validate a document and start importing it in the background, answering straight away with the job to ask after.

args.description: The document to read the project out of.

get_import_project_status.title: Read import
get_import_project_status.description: Read where one background import has got to, its progress lines included while it is still running.

cancel_import_project.title: Cancel import
cancel_import_project.description: Stop one background import. What it already wrote stays written.

list_deliverables_for_task.title: List deliverables
list_deliverables_for_task.description: List what one task owes, in order.

args.description: The task whose deliverables to list.

list_acceptance_criteria_for_task.title: List acceptance criteria
list_acceptance_criteria_for_task.description: List the conditions one task has to satisfy, in order.

args.description: The task whose criteria to list.

write_acceptance_criteria_result.title: Write review result
write_acceptance_criteria_result.description: Record what the reviewer found against one condition.

args.description: What the reviewer saw, in their own words.

create_task_todo.title: Create step
create_task_todo.description: Create one step of a task's decomposition. A step with predecessors lands blocked and is not dispatched until they finish.

get_task_todo.title: Read step
get_task_todo.description: Read one step of a decomposition.

dispatch_task_todo.title: Dispatch step
dispatch_task_todo.description: Announce one step so a worker picks it up, releasing it from its hold first if it is still blocked.

update_task_todo_status.title: Set step status
update_task_todo_status.description: Move one step to a new lifecycle state.

list_task_todos.title: List a run's steps
list_task_todos.description: List the steps belonging to one run.

args.description: The run whose steps to list.

create_workflow_run.title: Create run
create_workflow_run.description: Open one run. An empty name is generated, and a name already taken is refused.

args.description: The run's label. Generated when empty.
Who or what asked for it.

create_recovery_workflow_run.title: Create recovery run
create_recovery_workflow_run.description: Open a run that answers another's failure, charged against its lineage's shared budget.

args.description: The run's label. Generated when empty.
Who or what asked for it.
The run whose failure spawned this one.
The top of the chain, which holds the budget.

list_workflow_runs.title: List runs
list_workflow_runs.description: List runs newest first, or the single run carrying one label.

args.description: Keep only the run with this label.

list_workflow_runs_stale_since.title: List quiet runs
list_workflow_runs_stale_since.description: List the runs still in flight that no event has touched since the cutoff and that have not already been announced as timed out.

args.description: The instant a run must have been quiet since, as an RFC 3339 string.

list_workflow_runs_step_stale_since.title: List stuck steps
list_workflow_runs_step_stale_since.description: List the runs still in flight whose current step began before the cutoff and has not moved.

args.description: The instant a step must have started before, as an RFC 3339 string.

update_workflow_run_status.title: Set run status
update_workflow_run_status.description: Move one run to a new lifecycle state. The move is checked against the state machine.

args.description: Why it moved. Recorded when the run fails.

get_workflow_run_closure.title: Read run closure
get_workflow_run_closure.description: Read everything one run produced — its tasks, its steps, the edges between them, and the outside things it touched.

args.description: The run whose closure to read.

list_tasks_for_run.title: List a run's tasks
list_tasks_for_run.description: List the tasks belonging to one run.

args.description: The run whose tasks to list.

link_task_to_run.title: Link task to run
link_task_to_run.description: Record that one task belongs to one run, so rolling the run back reaches it.

link_todo_to_run.title: Link step to run
link_todo_to_run.description: Record that one step belongs to one run, so rolling the run back reaches it.

set_failure_budget.title: Set recovery budget
set_failure_budget.description: Say how many recovery activations one lineage is allowed. Meaningful on the root run.

args.description: The run whose budget to set.

increment_failure_budget.title: Charge recovery budget
increment_failure_budget.description: Charge one recovery activation against a lineage's budget and say what is left. Charging the same child twice is a no-op.

args.description: The top of the chain, which holds the budget.

rollback_workflow_run.title: Roll run back
rollback_workflow_run.description: Undo one run: move it to rolling_back, compensate what it produced, then finish it as rolled_back.

delete_workflow_run_artifacts.title: Compensate run artifacts
delete_workflow_run_artifacts.description: Reset the tasks one run produced and soft-delete its steps. Refused while another run still depends on one of them.

args.description: The run whose artifacts to compensate.

cancel_workflow_run.title: Cancel run
cancel_workflow_run.description: Begin cancelling one run, giving in-flight work until the deadline to quiesce, and cancel every task it holds that has not finished.

args.description: When in-flight work must have stopped by, as an RFC 3339 string.

finalize_workflow_run_cancellation.title: Finish cancelling run
finalize_workflow_run_cancellation.description: Close out a run whose quiesce deadline has passed.

touch_workflow_run_last_event_at.title: Mark run alive
touch_workflow_run_last_event_at.description: Record that an event touched one run, which is what keeps the watchdog off it.

args.description: When it was touched, as an RFC 3339 string.

mark_timeout_published.title: Mark timeout announced
mark_timeout_published.description: Record that a timeout was already announced for one run, so it is announced once.

handle_run_timeout.title: Handle run timeout
handle_run_timeout.description: Act on one run having gone quiet for too long.

handle_task_timeout.title: Handle step timeout
handle_task_timeout.description: Act on one task or step having stalled inside a run.

args.description: The task or step that stalled.
